decisions.surgical_unit_backup_plan: The surgical recovery unit will be notified of the delay and provided with an estimated time of arrival for the lift.

commitments.detail: A safety check will be performed on the lift before deployment.
A documented handoff will be completed and provided to the medical unit upon lift deployment.

decisions.surgical_unit_backup_plan: The surgical recovery unit will be notified of the delay and will be prepared to use the lift as soon as it becomes available.
